nodes.statement: Statement: The rigidity of the solution space is governed by the topological symmetry of the constraint matrix, analogous to crystal lattice symmetry where high symmetry implies degenerate (fat) ground states.

Statement: The "conductivity" of the parameter landscape during L-BFGS-B optimization dictates N_c(w); a highly conductive (smooth) landscape allows narrow networks to find solutions, while a rugged landscape requires wider networks (higher capacity) to navigate.
